instagram_caption:
Jesus, I am scared to watch my mother get weaker?

She is not scared of the hospital. She is scared of the room, and of being the daughter who is not strong enough to sit in it.

"You bring your not enough into that room, and I will be in there too."

Ruth 1:16 is the vow of someone who refused to leave: where you go I will go. It was never about having the strength. It was about staying.

You do not have to be steady to stay. You just have to stay.
